lines.text: Up 285% on the year: Ninetales (EX Hidden Legends) 22/101 went from $2.87 on Oct 23, 2025 to $11.05 on Oct 26, and is up 3% over 7 days, up 18% over 30 days and up 66% over 90 days. That is its highest price on file, back to Feb 8, 2024, above the earlier peak of $10.77 on Oct 16. That beats its set over 30 days: up 18% against a +4.4% median for 37 EX Hidden Legends items priced $5.00 or more, and +0.6% for 9933 priced items across the market.
Rising Rivals, about 30 days: 11 of 33 priced cards up 10% or more, 1 down 10% or more. Start prices Sep 26, end Oct 26, TCGplayer market.
